title: Shift handoff
summary: Record the impact, the evidence collected, and the next action so the receiving team can pick up the issue.

checks.text: Record the affected service, approximate start time and time zone, and who is affected.
Separate observed symptoms from hypotheses. Note the checks already tried and their results.
Record the current owner, the next check, and when the next update is due.

handoff: Impact: [users or service] · Evidence: [checks and results] · Current owner: [team] · Next action: [check and time]

title: DNS resolution
summary: Separate name resolution from general connectivity and establish which resolver should answer.

checks.text: Confirm the exact hostname, any error, and whether another approved hostname works from the same device.
Check whether the affected device has approved network or VPN connectivity. Internal names may require the corporate network.
Compare the device’s configured DNS resolver and results with a known working device on the same network. Record any timeouts or name errors.

handoff: Record the hostname, network or VPN state, resolver tested, exact response, and whether a second device sees the same issue.

title: Identity and MFA
summary: Find where sign-in fails and follow the approved recovery process for access problems.

checks.text: Capture the exact sign-in stage and error. Confirm whether one app or multiple approved services are affected.
Ask whether the user changed devices recently and whether the expected sign-in method is still available. Never request a password or MFA code.
Use the organization’s identity verification and recovery workflow. Escalate unexpected prompts or unfamiliar sign-in activity through the security channel.

handoff: Record the affected app, error stage, and approved recovery steps attempted. Omit codes, passwords, and personal identifiers.

title: Endpoint connectivity
summary: Work from the affected device outward to narrow down a wired, wireless, or VPN issue.

checks.text: Determine whether the issue affects one device, one area, or the entire site. Compare with a nearby working device.
Check the wired link or wireless association and verify the device is using the expected network.
Verify the expected address, gateway, and VPN status. If a switch port or VLAN may be involved, coordinate with the network team.

handoff: Record the affected area, wired or wireless connection, the last known working time, and the checks already performed.
